description:
Bible Question Answered – Calendar Systems & White Christian Nationalism

In this episode of “I’d Like to Know”, Pastors Stephen Bohr, C.A. Murray, and David Salazar respond to two current and important questions facing many Seventh-day Adventist believers.

01:02 – Should Christians follow the Gregorian calendar?
A viewer asks how we reconcile living by a man-made calendar system (the Gregorian calendar), when the Bible presents a creation-based model of time: “Evening and morning” marking the first day, second day, etc.
The pastors provide biblical clarity on Sabbath-keeping, God’s timekeeping system, and practical faithfulness in a secular world.

15:30 – What is the SDA Church’s position on White Christian Nationalism?
With rising social and political tension, another viewer asks where the Seventh-day Adventist Church stands regarding Christian Nationalism, specifically the White Christian Nationalist movement.
This segment addresses the Church’s official stance, historical principles of church-state separation, and biblical teachings on unity in Christ vs. nationalism.

📘 Bible Question Answered every Tuesday at 4 PM PT on SUMtv — honest questions, scriptural answers.

💬 Got a question? Leave it in the comments — it might be featured in a future episode.
